recognize_zh: 血液抹片中的顆粒球細胞質淡灰、顆粒明顯減少，核染色質粗塊狀、分葉不良（類 Pelger 樣）；背景紅血球大小不一並可見卵圓形大紅血球，提示骨髓發育不良（MDS）的顆粒球系與紅血球系異常。
features: Neutrophil with hyposegmented, band-like/partially cleft nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huet change)
Hypogranular pale grey cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Red cells show anisocytosis with macrocytes and occasional ovalocytes
No circulating blasts in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cell anisocytosis with macrocytes and scattered ovalocytes. A neutrophil displays a hyposegmented nucleus with markedly clumped chromatin and hypogranular pale cytoplasm, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet change and hypogranulation. Platelets are few in this field and no blasts are seen. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis and suggestive of a myelodysplastic neoplasm, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Congenital Pelger-Huet affects most neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired change is partial and accompanied by hypogranulation.
Morphology can be identical; drug history and reversibility after withdrawal distinguish it.
Lymphocytes lack the pale granular neutrophilic cytoplasm and dense clumped segmented-type chromatin seen here.
